Our story

It started with one oven and a stubborn recipe

Bloom opened as a single countertop oven in the back of a flower shop — hence the name — and a loaf of sourdough that took three years to get right.

Today the ovens run before sunrise so the case is full by 7. We still mill some of our own flour, still let the dough take its time, and still close the shop when the last tray sells out — some days that's noon, some days it's four.

Everything here is made to be shared: over a counter, at a table, or boxed up and carried home still warm.

— Mia, founder & head baker

On the counter today

A little taste of everything
